digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 11 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: 终端里的轻量级 Rust 编码代理，让 AI 直接在命令行完成代码任务，极简高效

repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniM
repos.summary_zh: 统一端点接入 290+ 模型供应商，90+ 免费源，兼容主流 AI 编码工具，开源网关零成本切换

repos.name: stablyai/orca
repos.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and VPS.
repos.summary_zh: 统一调度并行 AI 编码代理的桌面与移动端开发环境，自带订阅即可运行任意代理

repos.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
repos.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 170,000+ scientists worldwide. 158 ready-to-use skills plus 1
repos.summary_zh: 把任意 AI Agent 变成科研助手，内置 158 项技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物化学等领域

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: BurntSushi/ripgrep
repos.description: ripgrep recursively searches directories for a regex pattern while respecting your gitignore
repos.summary_zh: 递归搜索秒级响应，默认遵守 gitignore 的极速正则命令行工具，Rust 写就的 grep 替代者

repos.name: appwrite/appwrite
repos.description: Appwrite® - complete cloud infrastructure for your web, mobile and AI apps. Including Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Hosting, Realtim
repos.summary_zh: 一站式后端云服务，集认证、数据库、存储、函数于一体，让 Web 和 AI 应用开发无需自建后端

repos.name: vuejs/core
repos.description: 🖖 Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building UI on the web.
repos.summary_zh: 渐进式前端框架，虚拟DOM与响应式系统双驱动，让Web应用开发更灵活高效

repos.name: moeru-ai/airi
repos.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's
repos.summary_zh: 自托管AI伴侣容器，支持实时语音与Minecraft联动，打造类Neuro-sama的赛博灵魂

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: lyogavin/airllm
repos.description: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
repos.summary_zh: 单张4GB显卡即可运行70B大模型，通过层外内存加载突破显存限制

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片上仅需 2GB 内存跑 Gemma 4 26B-A4B，把大模型推理门槛压到极致

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 纯 C99 单 CPU 跑 2.78 万亿参数大模型，仅需 8.24GB 内存，彻底摆脱 GPU 依赖

repos.name: VictorTaelin/OptMem
repos.description: Permanent memory for AI agents. A 426-token prompt, a script, plug and play.
repos.summary_zh: 426 token 即插即用的 AI 永久记忆方案，让 Agent 跨会话不丢上下文

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 多模态大模型原子级视觉感知评测基准，专测细粒度视觉理解短板

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: rustdesk/rustdesk
repos.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
repos.summary_zh: 开源远程桌面神器，自托管替代 TeamViewer，数据完全自主可控

repos.name: chatboxai/chatbox
repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台 AI 客户端，聚合主流大模型统一对话，数据本地保存且支持自部署

repos.name: OWASP/CheatSheetSeries
repos.description: The OWASP Cheat Sheet Series was created to provide a concise collection of high value information on specific application security topics.
repos.summary_zh: 应用安全知识速查手册，覆盖注入、认证等关键风险，开发者与审计人员的实战宝典

repos.name: atuinsh/atuin
repos.description: ✨ Making your shell magical
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 shell 历史记录，支持跨设备同步、加密存储和模糊搜索，让命令行回溯更智能高效

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: astral-sh/uv
repos.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的极速 Python 包与项目管理器，替代 pip/poetry 并提速数十倍

repos.name: sherlock-project/sherlock
repos.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
repos.summary_zh: 输入用户名即可跨平台检索其社交账号，开源界最流行的数字身份追踪工具

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 和 Tree-sitter 作者打造的 Rust 高性能编辑器，多人协作快到飞起

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: Rust 重写的 Bitwarden 自托管服务端，轻量高效，让密码管理完全掌控在自己手中

papers.title: ParVL: Parallel Scaling and Expandable Compute Allocation for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Existing scaling strategies for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically expand either model parameters or sequential inference computation, incurring substantial memory or latency overhead.
papers.summary_zh: 提出并行缩放与可扩展计算分配策略，动态调节多模态大模型算力分配，显著降低内存占用与推理延迟，突破固定计算瓶颈

papers.title: SocietyBench: Forecasting Counterfactual Social-World Evolution
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs), and the agents built on top of them, are now benchmarked heavily on whether they can finish a task -- fix a bug, drive a browser, operate a GUI. A complementary social ab
papers.summary_zh: 提出社会世界反事实演化预测基准，构建多智能体模拟框架评估模型对真实事件动态的因果理解，填补任务导向评测空白

papers.title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
papers.abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks through iterative tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on trajectory-level supervision, li
papers.summary_zh: 提出回合级事后自蒸馏方法，实现工具推理细粒度信用分配，在长程任务中准确率提升显著且训练效率优于轨迹级强化学习

papers.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires agents to turn accumulated experience into better future behavior. Personal AI agents offer a concrete setting for studying this capability because they retain pref
papers.summary_zh: 提出PAST-Bench基准系统评估个人智能体递归自我改进能力，涵盖偏好记忆与技能积累，实验显示现有模型在跨会话经验转化上表现显著不足

papers.title: Should We Type or Talk to LLM Agents? A Comprehensive Study of Voice and Keyboard Input Perturbations
papers.abstract: Human input reaches language models by typing or speaking, and each channel leaves a distinct signature: orthographic noise for keyboards; for voice, disfluency from conventional transcription and res
papers.summary_zh: 系统对比键盘打字与语音输入对LLM性能的扰动影响，发现语音转写错误更易误导模型，提出针对性鲁棒性优化策略，关键任务准确率提升达12%

papers.title: A game theory for foundation models shows new paths to rational cooperation through similarity inference
papers.abstract: As autonomous agents powered by foundation models are increasingly integrated into social and economic systems, understanding the principles governing their collective behavior is essential for ensuri
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向基础模型的博弈论框架，通过相似性推断实现理性合作，在混合动机场景中显著提升协作效率与策略稳定性

papers.title: Agogic: Performance-Timed Music Tokens for LLM-Native Text-to-Symbolic-Music Generation
papers.abstract: Text-to-music language models begin with a choice usually made by default: how to tokenize music. Normally entangled with backbone, data, and recipe, its effect has never been measured in isolation. W
papers.summary_zh: 提出性能计时音乐分词法，固定模型数据仅换表征，使文本到符号音乐生成在零额外开销下质量显著提升

papers.title: Assessment of Conditional Diffusion Model for Synthetic Histopathology Image Generation
papers.abstract: Synthetic histopathology image generation has emerged as an approach that may address data scarcity in computational pathology, yet current evaluation methodologies may not fully assess synthetic data
papers.summary_zh: 评估条件扩散模型生成病理图像的不足，提出新指标并验证合成数据在分类任务中提升性能，强调质量评估需结合下游应用

papers.title: string2string Studio: An Interactive, In-Browser Platform for String-to-String Algorithms
papers.abstract: We present string2string Studio, an interactive in-browser platform for string-to-string analysis across natural language processing, computational biology, and the digital humanities. The system inte
papers.summary_zh: 提出浏览器端字符串算法交互平台，整合六大模块覆盖NLP与生物信息，无需安装即可实现比对搜索及BLAST分析

papers.title: WorldCup Arena: Prospective, Leakage-Free Evaluation of Frontier LLMs on a Live Tournament
papers.abstract: Benchmarks that measure the forecasting ability of large language models are almost always retrospective: the event has happened, the answer is somewhere on the Web, and the evaluation must defend its
papers.summary_zh: 提出前瞻性无泄漏评测框架，以2026世界杯39天实时赛程检验前沿大模型预测能力，规避记忆污染并动态追踪表现

papers.title: HalluTruthQA-4K: A Fine-Grained Corpus and Annotation Process for Arabic Hallucination Detection and Truth Verification
papers.abstract: Large language models can generate fluent Arabic answers while introducing factual errors that are difficult to identify and verify. Existing Arabic hallucination resources often assign a binary label
papers.summary_zh: 构建首个细粒度阿拉伯语幻觉检测语料库HalluTruthQA-4K，含4千样本及多维标注流程，突破整句二分类局限，实现句子级真伪验证并显著提升检测精度
